text:
kevin_partnerships: Quick heads-up: PM asked if we can align a joint marketplace + SI announcement the week of June 22. Hardware status is mixed across vendors (H100/H200/B200 mostly green; MI300 and Gaudi have open validation work). Can we surface blockers here?
anna_amd: MI300 still in partner validation. ETA shrinking but not nailed — targeting late June for partner beta. I'll confirm tomorrow with an exact ship window.
tony_nvidia: H200 telemetry looks good; H100 perf profiles signed off. We can support an announce with H100/H200/B200 live. We can also provide a H200 test image to SI.
pablo_si: From SI readiness: two big items block a single-wave announce: 1) a finalized SI image set per SKU; 2) updated test cert matrix + runbook for partners. If MI300/Gaudi arrive late, we need clear public messaging for "compatibility preview" and partner-only early access.
dina_cloud: Ops note: marketplace listings require SKU taxonomy, SKU IDs, and image URIs 72 hours before publish. We also need region availability mapping for the announcement. If MI300 is late, we can still publish core SKUs and add MI300 in a follow-up patch release.
marta_gaudi: Gaudi runtime team found a scheduling edge-case that impacts multi-instance scaling across host NICs. Patch in review, may land in 5-7 business days if tests pass.
kevin_partnerships: Proposed approach: 1) public announce (H100/H200/B200) on 2026-06-22; 2) MI300 & Gaudi marked as "partner preview" with separate partner-only handover; 3) two-week window for adding SKUs if vendor confirms before 6/18. Owners: comms=kevin_partnerships, SI cert=pablo_si, marketplace ops=dina_cloud, vendor liaison=anna_amd/marta_gaudi/tony_nvidia, legal=sam_legal.
sam_legal: Ok for "partner preview" language. Avoid dates in public copy; use "expected later in Q2" or "targeting late June". For joint press, require partner sign-off on assets 48 hours before release.
li_johnson: Marketing asks: can we get a single-line compatibility matrix for the announcement page? i.e., which SKUs are recommended for x workload class. It can be high-level.
pablo_si: I'll produce a one-paragraph guidance and a short table for ops (recommended SKUs for inference, training, and mixed workloads). Will tag it "prelim" and update after MI300/Gaudi validation.
dina_cloud: Ops actions: reserve SKU namespace: market::gpu:{h100,h200,b200,mi300,gaudi}-v1; prepare two release-note templates (public + partner-only); and schedule region rollout: canary in us-west1 -> eu-central -> rest. All due by 6/18.
release-bot: Calendar event created: "Marketplace joint announce (H100/H200/B200)"  2026-06-22  https://calendar.redwood.ai/e/marketplace-joint-2026-06-22
kevin_partnerships: Contingency: if MI300 or Gaudi confirm before 6/18, we flip a feature flag and add SKU URIs up to 48h pre-announce. If not, we publish core wave and follow up with a partner-only advisory + marketplace patch in July.
marta_gaudi: We'll prioritize the scaling patch and push an early validation image to partners if tests look good. I'll post the build SHA here when available.
anna_amd: I'll escalate MI300 batch timing internally and report back tomorrow.
tony_nvidia: We'll deliver H200 test image by EOD Wed and confirm firmware tags.
pablo_si: Action list posted: SI image set draft (pablo_si), cert matrix PR (pablo_si), marketplace SKU stub (dina_cloud), comms draft (kevin_partnerships), legal checklist (sam_legal). I'll open PRs and tag owners.
kevin_partnerships: Thanks team 44d please keep this thread for updates only. If a vendor updates ETA, ping here immediately. Closing for now; will reopen if dates shift. :calendar:
